events.title: Undying Soul Demo Updated for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Explore the new prologue, take on reworked boss battles, discover the new Treasure Room and its Mimic enemies, and experiment with the new Relic system. The update also brings a new hat-like enemy, breakable objects, visual improvements, and an enhanced inventory. Run progress is now saved more consistently.Try the updated demo and let me know what you think. If you enjoy the demo, adding it to your wishlist really helps.
